muck.name: Tessellate
muck.desc: A tall snow leopard with smoky grey rosettes and pale blue eyes behind little wire-frame glasses. She wears a black hoodie with a tiny embroidered wizard hat on the chest and has a pencil tucked behind one ear. Her long, thick tail is never quite still.
